title: Pullback and Direct Image of Parabolic Ample and Parabolic Nef Vector Bundles
summary: We prove that under a finite surjective map of irreducible smooth complex projective curves, the pullback and direct image of a parabolic ample (respectively, parabolic nef) vector bundle is again parabolic ample (respectively, parabolic nef) if and only if the original parabolic vector bundle is parabolic ample (respectively, parabolic nef).
